## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are encountering.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of the desired behavior or API design.

## Architectural Considerations
- Does this belong in Cliffracer core or as a standalone extension package under `packages/`?
- How does this adhere to the "Explicit over Permissive" design tenet?
- What are the operational failure modes if the broker is unreachable?

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code snippets, or diagrams.
